entries.title: Psalms 142:1
segments: ¶<<An instruction of David; when he was in the cave: a prayer.>> I cry unto Jehovah with my voice: with my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.

entries.title: Psalms 142:2
segments: I pour out my plaint before him; I shew before him my trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 142:3
segments: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then *thou* knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they hidden a snare for me.

entries.title: Psalms 142:4
segments: ¶Look on the right hand and see; there is no man that knoweth me: refuge hath failed me; no man careth for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 142:5
segments: I cried unto thee, Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 142:6
segments: Attend unto my cry, for I am brought very low; deliver me from my persecutors, for they are stronger than I.

entries.title: Psalms 142:7
segments: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may celebrate thy name. The righteous shall surround me, because thou dealest bountifully with me.
